title: The class 𝓜 is closed under the rescalings μ ↦ ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ)•μ.map(dilation y λ), 0 < λ < 1, ‖y‖ ≤ 1 − λ (property (3); conditional on blowup_calculus and blowup_imrep)
statement: Assume (BC) — the frozen type of the selected node's registered dependency blowup_calculus: for all P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), x ∈ ℝ^P and λ > 0: (i) M_W(blowUp T x λ) = ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ)·M_{(dilation x λ)⁻¹(W)}(T) for every W; (ii) currentEval (blowUp T x λ) ω = currentEval T (affinePullbackForm (dilationCLM P λ) (−(λ⁻¹•x)) ω) for every n-form ω on ℝ^P; (iii) currentEval (blowUp (blowUp T x λ) y μ) ω = currentEval (blowUp T (x + λ•y) (λμ)) ω for all y ∈ ℝ^P, μ > 0 and n-forms ω. Assume also (BUI) — the frozen type of the selected node's registered dependency blowup_imrep (the reused accepted rep_pushforward): for all P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), x ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and every IMRep R of T in U there is an IMRep R′ in dilation x λ '' U representing blowUp T x λ with R′.measure(s) = ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ)·R.measure((dilation x λ)⁻¹(s)) for every Borel s. Let n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k and 1 ≤ n, let U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} be open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U. Let z ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and r > 0 with B̄_{2r}(z) ⊆ U, and let RT be an IMRep of T in U; write μ_T := RT.measure, W := B_{2r}(z) and η_{a,t} := dilation a t (η_{a,t}(v) = t⁻¹(v − a)). Let 𝓜 be a set of measures on ℝ^{n+k} such that μ ∈ 𝓜 if and only if either (PS) μ = ofReal(t⁻¹ⁿ) • (μ_T⌞W).map η_{a,t} for some a ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and some t with 0 < t ≤ r and dist(a, z) ≤ r − t; or (ZS) μ = RS.measure for some S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) and some IMRep RS of S in ℝ^{n+k} for which there are points c_i, scales t_i > 0 (i ∈ ℕ) and a point b with dist(c_i, z) < r − t_i for every i, t_i → 0, c_i → b, and blowUp T c_i t_i ⇀ S in ℝ^{n+k} (ConvergesWeakly). (These are the selected node's positive-scale members μ_{x,λ} and zero-scale members, with (a, t) = (z + rx, rλ), c_i = z + rx_i, t_i = rλ_i, b = z + rx̄.) Then for every μ ∈ 𝓜, every y ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and every λ with 0 < λ < 1 and ‖y‖ ≤ 1 − λ, the measure ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ) • μ.map (dilation y λ) belongs to 𝓜.
